limitations: Only one Gmail account was accessible: subscriptions.6@faiblemedia.com. Other company mailboxes (e.g. subscriptions.1@) were not audited.
The mailbox appears to be new: the earliest message is dated 2026-04-30, so any earlier billing history is not covered.
The Gmail connector cannot download attachment contents; the three PDF invoices (Apr-Jun) were not opened. Tax, subtotal, billing period and payment method are unknown for all transactions.
Hosted Stripe invoice links in the Aug-Oct invoice emails could not be fetched.
Transaction dates are invoice email dates in UTC, not payment timestamps.
Pinterest emails (about half the mailbox) were excluded by sender from the line-by-line review; a keyword search for billing terms in Pinterest mail returned nothing.
Billing interval is inferred from invoice cadence; no July 2026 invoice was found.
Only vendors with payment evidence are counted as subscriptions; vendors with account or marketing emails only are listed as unverified items.
